title: BEST way to travel from BANGKOK to CHIANG MAI Thailand | Travel Vlog Ep. 24
description:
Misha turns into a model and Steven gets a new microphone. 

Starting in Bangkok, we spent the whole day traveling to Chiang Mai and of course had lots of fun along the way. It was our first time taking the train in Thailand and it was pretty nice to get a bed and stretch our leg instead of being cramped in a bus like we've done multiple times in the past.
